messages:
jamal: Heads-up: need a decision on routing priority for requests that include both org_key and project_key. Default today is project affinity, but billing/quota telemetry suggests org-first could make sense. Thoughts? cc @priya @anna
priya: I lean project-first by default. Keeps per-project quotas accurate and avoids accidental cross-project billing. :thinking_face:
anna: +1 project-first default. We should add an explicit exception rule for org-admin keys (org-level intents). Also console should display which key resolved the billing/quota.
rick: Concern: project-first can cause hot spots on project pools. If many projects under same org spike, org-first routing to a shared org pool may be better for capacity smoothing. Would like telemetry before we bake this.
marta: We can emit an auth.routing.outcome metric with tags (key_type, key_origin, routed_pool). That will let us see distribution and failures. I can add it to prod.
jamal: Quick policy sketch:
```
auth_routing:
  default: project_first
  exceptions:
    - when: key_role == 'org_admin'
      action: prefer_org
    - when: project.quota_overflow == true
      action: fallback_org
```
priya: Prefer making it explicit: require clients to set X-Routing-Hint when they want org affinity (or use a key scoped to org). Simpler semantics and fewer surprises.
anna: Console UX: show a "routing hint" toggle when creating keys and surface which key was used in key details (link to routed pool + telemetry). I'll mock this tomorrow.
ops-bot: canary deploy scheduled: auth-routing-v2 -> canary pool at 03:00 UTC. Rollout window 30m. :bell:
rick: Let's also run a synthetic canary that simulates quota surge across 30 projects to validate fallback behavior. Add it to canary plan.
marta: I'll add the metric + dashboard panel. Draft query: `sum by (routed_pool, key_type) (increase(auth_routing_outcome[5m]))` — will share link when ready.
jamal: Action items: priya implement header + flag RFC; marta add metric & dashboard; anna UX toggle + key detail link; rick design surge canary; i'll draft migration PR for routing config and fallback tests. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
priya: SG, i'll open an RFC PR in eng-platform with schema + header semantics later today.
anna: I'll add a changelog note and update the quota mismatch runbook.
thread_summary: Decision thread about default auth routing priority (project-first vs org-first), proposed config sketch, telemetry metric addition, console UX toggle, canary deploy schedule, and action items assigned.
